name: AI DJ: your own personal DJ, even solo
object: AI DJ, Spotify Premium's personalised AI host that picks and introduces tracks for you
audience: young Premium listeners who want the fun of a DJ at a party without needing an actual party
message: This video tells young Premium listeners that even home alone, nursing a rough night, they can have their own personal AI DJ throw them a one-person party.

moments.what: A guy lies dazed in a neck brace on a plaid-covered bed, clearly recovering from a wild night; the shot holds on his groggy, confused face.
moments.copy: Can't understand this party, bro... sorry.

moments.what: His phone on the nightstand shows the AI DJ onboarding screen, a pulsing green ring reading 'Welcome DJ'; a new voice introduces itself as the camera cuts back to his face.
moments.copy: Hey, what's going on, Krish? I'm DJ X, your own personal AI DJ on Spotify.

moments.what: He admits he's alone but still wants to party; the phone screen switches to a 'Listening...' state as DJ X agrees to get things going.
moments.copy: I'm home alone, but I want to party. Party time, solo style. Let's get this going.

moments.what: The phone on the table now plays a track with cover art visible on the now-playing screen; music kicks in and his mood visibly lifts.
Wide shot of his room glowing green; bold 'AI DJ' title card appears with a line about Premium Platinum access.
moments.copy: Your personal DJ, AI DJ, only on Spotify Premium. AI DJ available only on Spotify Premium Platinum — check available Premium plans to learn more.

cta: A title card reading 'AI DJ' with a line directing viewers to check Premium Platinum plans, paired with a closing voice-over line that the AI DJ is exclusive to Premium.
why: The comic cold open (dazed, post-party, alone) sets up a real problem — wanting a party vibe with no one around — before the product solves it in character, as a voice rather than a UI feature. Hearing DJ X talk, then watching the mood visibly shift once music starts, makes the payoff feel earned rather than demonstrated in the abstract, and the Premium-only line at the end turns that feeling straight into a subscription pitch.
